BrowserFeature.syntax: Modern JavaScript, used by the whole client
BrowserFeature.esModules: JavaScript modules, used to load the client
BrowserFeature.bigInt: BigInt numbers, used by the server protocol
BrowserFeature.webSocket: WebSockets, used to connect to the server
BrowserFeature.cryptoRandom: Secure random numbers, used to log in
BrowserFeature.textEncoder: Text encoding, used by the server protocol
BrowserFeature.structuredClone: Structured cloning, used to track server requests
BrowserFeature.fetch: Fetch, used to load translations, servers and card data
BrowserFeature.indexedDB: IndexedDB storage, used for cards, decks and settings
BrowserFeature.resizeObserver: Resize observers, used to lay out the game board
BrowserFeature.webCrypto: Password hashing, which needs a page served over https://; passwords are sent to the server unhashed instead
BrowserFeature.worker: Web Workers, used to keep the connection alive in a background tab
BrowserFeature.broadcastChannel: Broadcast channels, used by the pop-out card preview
BrowserFeature.clipboard: The clipboard, used by copy buttons (needs a page served over https://)
